d:
This is not just a travel video, this is my personal journey.
I’m Sajid Shah, a photographer, and this film is about my solo trip to Parasnath.
Ghar se sirf 70km door, ek aisa pahad jise main bachpan se dekhta aaya hoon… aur finally aaj usse chadhne ka mauka mila.
Bike ride se lekar Madhuban trek tak, har moment ne mujhe test kiya.
Thakaan, darr, aur excitement — sab ek saath tha.
Yeh film sirf travel nahi, ek promise hai jo maine khud se kiya tha.
Agar aapko real aur raw travel stories pasand hai, support zaroor kare
